scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm start -w desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage -w desktop && npm run pack -w desktop
